Entries.Text: GRASS Builder
GRASS Builder
GRASS files are used by Sekiro, Elden Ring, Armored Core VI and Nightreign.

Give the loaded map piece or asset a GRASS file, built from its meshes. The game grows dynamic grass on the GRASS mesh, using the density of each vertex in six slots. The part in the MSB picks the grass type of each slot (its six GrassTypeParam IDs).
File
The GRASS file of the model loaded in this view.
Load a map piece or asset to build its GRASS file.
{0} isn't a map piece or asset. Only those use a GRASS file: only map piece and asset parts name the grass types.
{0} isn't a map piece. In Sekiro only map pieces (mapbnd) use a GRASS file: no object has one, and only map piece parts name the grass types.
{0} isn't an asset. In Armored Core VI only assets (geombnd) use a GRASS file: no map piece part names a grass type.

This is an open-world tile map piece. Their parts name grass types, but no vanilla one holds a GRASS file: the open world's grass comes from somewhere else. Whether the game reads a GRASS file here is untested.
{0} has no GRASS file. Choose the meshes to grow grass on and the starting densities, then build one.

Meshes
The FLVER meshes whose triangles (LOD 0) make up the GRASS mesh.
{0} of {1} meshes chosen.
Choose All
Choose every mesh of the model.
Choose None
Clear the chosen meshes.
Mesh {0}: {1} ({2} triangles)
Whether this mesh's triangles go into the GRASS mesh. Ground meshes are the usual choice.
Faces
Which of the chosen meshes' triangles are kept, by the way they face.
Steepest: %.0f degrees from up
Triangles facing further from straight up than this are left out. 90 keeps walls, 180 keeps every triangle. Vanilla GRASS files cover walls and overhangs too.
{0} of {1} triangles kept.
Densities
The density every vertex starts with, per slot. 0 grows none of that slot's grass, 1 is full density.
Slot {0}: %.2f
The density of slot {0}, whose grass type is the part's grass ID {0} in the MSB (GrassTypeParamID{0} in Sekiro, GrassParamId{0} in Elden Ring).
Every slot is 0, so the file would grow no grass.
Actions
Build the GRASS file from the settings above. The build can be undone.
This map piece already has a GRASS file. Rebuilding replaces its mesh and painted densities with the settings above.
Build GRASS File
Build {0} from the chosen meshes. It is added to the model's binder, beside its FLVER, when the model is saved.
Rebuild GRASS File
Replace the contents of {0} with a mesh built from the chosen meshes.
